content: Reyansh Tiwari called Vikram Patel from Omni Insurance Group to inquire about his expired health policy (which lapsed on September 15, 2026). Since the 30-day renewal window closed on October 15, 2026, a new policy with underwriting and a $1,350 annual premium is required. Vikram offered a 3-month short-term emergency coverage rider for $120. Vikram agreed to email the short-term rider quote and exact policy expiration details (September 15, 2026 at 11:59 PM) to the customer.

action_items: Vikram to email the short-term rider quote to the customer
Vikram to email the exact policy expiration confirmation to the customer
Reyansh to review the information and follow up
